title: VIXEN configure/build roots diverge
body: The documented VIXEN preset must be invoked from VIXEN/, but the generated build directory is repository-level build/wsl; invoking cmake --build build/wsl from VIXEN/ fails before doing work. Consolidate the workflow so preset and build targets expose one stable root or wrapper.

title: Native AMD lane needs manual Ninja/toolchain provisioning
body: The native witness required tools/vixen-native.sh prepare to download/provision Ninja before the queued build could run. The lane setup did not make the pinned native toolchain available declaratively; consolidate provisioning and admission into the native build contract.

title: Recipe tape position-stack binding is not exposed to consumers
body: Moving positions out of private registers required the VIXEN witness to hand-allocate one 64-vec4-per-invocation SSBO region and add descriptor binding 4, pool capacity, writes, and cleanup. The kernel emitter currently documents but does not expose a consumer allocation/descriptor contract; consolidate this storage/binding seam.

title: Native GPU benchmark output is hidden by CTest buffering
body: The required per-depth native compile timings were only observable by bypassing CTest and invoking the Windows gtest executable through cmd.exe; CTest buffered the diagnostic lines and the depth-64 stall had no useful partial result. Consolidate a native GPU benchmark runner that streams per-depth measurements while preserving the queued route.
